# Settings

<!-- Generated by tools/Metaphor.SettingsReference from the settings in code: edit those, not this page. -->

Every setting the mod reads from its settings file, what each does, and its default. You never need to change any of
them: with no file, everything is on. They are there so a player with some sight can turn off the parts they don't
need.

## The settings file

1. Find the mod's settings folder: `User\Mods\metaphor.accessibility` inside your Reloaded-II folder.
   `[NEEDS VERIFICATION]` The folder is checked in the game later.
2. In it, create or open the text file `settings.json`.
3. Write the settings you want to change, and leave out the rest. Save the file.

A change applies at once, while the game runs, and the mod says what changed, such as "Menus: off." or "Keys
changed." You don't need to restart the game.

A value the mod can't use, such as the word "off" where `false` belongs, is ignored: that setting keeps its default,
and the mod's log says which one. Settings the mod doesn't know are ignored too.

A file that turns off menu speech and the nearby list, and moves the repeat key to Q, reads:

```json
{
  "speech": { "menus": false },
  "field": { "nearby": false },
  "keys": { "dialogue": { "repeatKey": "Q" } }
}
```

## General

| Setting | What it does | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `voicedLines` | What is said for lines the actors speak: `auto`, `nameOnly`, `fullLine` or `nothing`. See [change how voiced lines are read](../how-to/change-how-voiced-lines-are-read.md). | `auto` |
| `checkForUpdates` | Whether the mod asks GitHub once per launch for a newer release. See [turn off the update check](../how-to/turn-off-the-update-check.md). | `true` |
| `soundCues` | Whether the mod plays its sound cues at all. | `true` |
| `soundCueVolume` | How loud the sound cues are, a whole number from 0, silent, to 100. | `50` |
| `welcomed` | Whether the welcome has been said. The mod sets it to `true` itself after the first launch; set it to `false` to hear the welcome again next time. | `false` |

## Features still being tested

A feature that needs a by-ear check can ship while it is still being tested. Its default is shown as `testing, off`
below: in a normal install it stays off until you set it to `true`, and it turns on by default in the release after
the check passes. Release builds never turn it on for you. For a contributor, a by-ear session
(`scripts/dev/session.ps1 deploy` or `run`) turns every testing feature on for that session only and never edits your
`settings.json`; a value you set in the file still wins. Passing the check is a one-line pull request that removes
`Testing = true` from the feature's `[SettingKey]` in its project's feature enum, which this page is generated from.

## Field

Inside a `field` object, `true` or `false`: `{ "field": { "whereAmI": false } }`. Off leaves that feature's keys to
the game.

| Setting | What it does | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `nearby` | The nearby list: N, or LB with Down and Up on the D-pad. | `true` |
| `nearbyCategories` | The nearby list's categories: `]` and `[`, or the pad chord if you bind one. | `true` |
| `whereAmI` | "Where am I": L, or LB with Left on the D-pad. | `true` |
| `guidance` | The guidance beep toward a nearby thing: G, or LB with Right on the D-pad. | `true` |
| `guidancePause` | The beep pausing, not ending, while the game has control (a cutscene or a line), and coming back once free roam has held. Needs `guidance`. | `true` |
| `reach` | The callout when a door or chest comes into reach: "Door, in reach". | `true` |
| `stunCallouts` | The callout when a field enemy near you is stunned: "Enemy stunned". | `true` |
| `shoulderHold` | In the field, LB and RB reach the game when you let go, so LB with RB (the reader) and LB with the D-pad open neither the popularity ranking nor the map. Tapped alone, they still open them. | `true` |
| `cameraTilt` | "Camera looking down" or "Camera looking up" when the camera tilts past a limit, "Camera level" when it comes back, and the camera's tilt at the end of "where am I". The limits are in `limits`. | `true` |
| `sonar` | A short sound for the people, objects and exits nearby, one at a time, nearest first (`field.sonarPings` for more): a sound of its own for each kind, on the side it is on screen, louder when nearer. It waits while the guidance beep guides or a route ping sounds. Still being tested. | testing, off |
| `wallTones` | A low steady tone for each wall near you, ahead, behind, left and right of the screen, louder as the wall nears. Silent on maps the mod has no walking map for, which it says once. The range and volume are in `limits`. | `true` |
| `routePings` | A ping from the direction of each place the nearby list steps to: two high notes when the way is straight, two rising notes from the next corner when the way bends, one low note when there is no path. Its volume is in `limits`. Still being tested. | testing, off |
| `soundFiles` | The sonar, wall tones and route pings play the mod's own sound files, in `data/sounds` in the mod folder, instead of plain tones. A missing or damaged file plays its plain tone. Still being tested. | testing, off |
| `enemyAwareness` | A sharp sound from the enemy's side and "Enemy noticed you" when a field enemy near you notices you, and a softer falling sound when it gives up the search. Each sound has its own key in `sounds`. Still being tested. | testing, off |
| `objectiveGuidance` | O starts the guidance beep toward the current objective's marker on this map, or a waypoint the mod's data gives; G stops it. Says "Objective guidance isn't ready for this area" on a map the game gives no minimap, where the mod can't place the marker. | `true` |
| `fieldStrikes` | "Hit" when a strike of yours takes HP from a field enemy near you, and "Defeated" when it takes the last. | `true` |
| `cornerAdvice` | The advice Gallica and the party give in the top-left corner as you roam, with the speaker's name, after the line before it. | `true` |
| `behindMuffle` | The sonar, route pings, wall tones and guidance beep sound duller and a little quieter when they come from behind the screen's facing, so front and back differ. The angle is in `limits`. Still being tested. | testing, off |
| `turnPings` | When you turn the camera, the sonar's last ping and a recent route ping play again from their new side, so turning tells you whether a sound is ahead or behind. The angle is in `limits`. Still being tested. | testing, off |
| `heightPan` | The sonar, route pings and guidance beep sit nearer the centre the farther above or below you their source is. Still being tested. | testing, off |
| `nearbyHeight` | The nearby list says "above" or "below" after the direction of a thing well above or below you, such as on another floor. Still being tested. | testing, off |
| `compass` | The nearby list says compass points, such as "north-east", from the map's own axes instead of directions from the screen, so they stay the same however the camera turns. North is the top of the game's map. Still being tested. | testing, off |
| `stickScan` | Hold RB and push the right stick: the nearest thing that way is said, such as "Left: Chest, 3 steps left", and the camera stays still. U says the nearest thing ahead, left, right and behind. Still being tested. | testing, off |
| `autoWalk` | While the guidance beep guides, H, or LB with Y on the pad, walks you toward it by pushing the left stick for you. Any button, key or stick you press stops it, and so does arriving, a line, a menu, a battle or a new area. Needs a controller connected. Still being tested. | testing, off |
| `mapCursor` | Hold V and use the arrow keys, or hold LB and push the right stick, to move a cursor over the map 5 steps at a time: it says what is there, open floor or wall, and how far and which way it is from you. Let go and it is back on you. While it is out, B (LB with R3) bookmarks the spot for this map, K and J (LB with D-pad Down and Up) jump to this map's bookmarks, and G (LB with D-pad Right) guides you there with the beep. Still being tested. | testing, off |

## Report

Inside a `report` object, `true` or `false`: `{ "report": { "silentScreens": false } }`. Both write only to
`report-log.txt` in the mod's folder; nothing is sent anywhere. See [report a problem](../how-to/install-the-mod.md#report-a-problem).

| Setting | What it does | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `markKey` | The mark key, F8: writes a numbered marker with the time to the report log and plays the mark sound. Off leaves F8 to the game. | `true` |
| `silentScreens` | Lists in the report log each screen and each move in a menu that the mod said nothing for. | `true` |

## Sounds

Each sound cue has its own setting inside a `sounds` object, with `on`, `true` or `false`, and `volume`, a whole number
from 0 to 100 that is a share of `soundCueVolume`: 50 plays it at half the sound cue volume.
[Sound cues](sound-cues.md) says what each sound means.

```json
{ "sounds": { "allyHit": { "on": false }, "enemyHit": { "volume": 50 } } }
```

| Setting | The sound | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `allyHit` | Someone in your party was hit. | on, volume 100 |
| `enemyHit` | An enemy was hit. | on, volume 100 |
| `mark` | The mark key wrote a marker. | on, volume 100 |
| `enemyNoticed` | A field enemy noticed you, from its side. Needs `field.enemyAwareness`. | on, volume 100 |
| `enemyGaveUp` | A field enemy gave up the search, from its side. Needs `field.enemyAwareness`. | on, volume 100 |

## Limits

Some features have a limit you can move, inside a `limits` object, then the feature's object, as a whole number.

```json
{ "limits": { "field": { "cameraDownDegrees": 50 } } }
```

| Setting | What it does | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `field.cameraDownDegrees` | How far down the camera tilts, from level, before "Camera looking down" (`cameraTilt`), in degrees. 1 to 89, in steps of 5. | `40` |
| `field.cameraUpDegrees` | How far up before "Camera looking up", in degrees. 1 to 89, in steps of 5. | `20` |
| `field.cameraMarginDegrees` | How far back inside a limit the camera comes before "Camera level", in degrees. 0 to 30, in steps of 1. | `5` |
| `field.wallRange` | How near a wall comes before its tone starts (`wallTones`), in the game's units, about 100 a step. 50 to 2000, in steps of 50. | `300` |
| `field.wallVolume` | How loud a wall tone is right at the wall. 0 to 100, in steps of 5. | `50` |
| `field.routePingVolume` | How loud a route ping is from a place in reach (`routePings`); farther places are quieter. 0 to 100, in steps of 5. | `90` |
| `shoulders.tapLength` | How long, in milliseconds, a lone `LB` or `RB` press holds the button down for the game when you let go, in the field (`shoulderHold`) and in a battle, where the mod keeps a held shoulder for its chords, a lone `LT` or `RT` press while `settingsMenu` or `keyHelp` holds them for its chord, and an `L3` tap in a battle while `battleHits` holds it for its status read. Raise it if the game misses taps. 20 to 200, in steps of 10. | `50` |
| `battle.statusHold` | How long, in milliseconds, `L3` is held alone in a battle before it says the party's HP (`battleHits`) instead of reaching the game as a tap (Retry). Raise it if a quick press says the status. 100 to 1000, in steps of 50. | `300` |
| `cues.sonarVolume` | How loud the field sonar's pings are, as a share of `soundCueVolume` (the master). Wall tones and route pings have their own, `field.wallVolume` and `field.routePingVolume`. 0 to 100, in steps of 5. | `100` |
| `field.sonarPings` | How many things the field sonar (`sonar`) pings at a time. 1 plays one at a time, cycling through what's nearby, nearest first; more plays the nearest few in a row. 1 to 6, in steps of 1. | `1` |
| `cues.guidanceVolume` | How loud the guidance beep is, as a share of `soundCueVolume`. 0 to 100, in steps of 5. | `100` |
| `cues.otherVolume` | How loud the one-shot sounds are (hits and the mark sound), as a share of `soundCueVolume`. 0 to 100, in steps of 5. | `100` |
| `field.behindMuffleDegrees` | How far round from straight ahead, in degrees either way, a navigation sound must come from to be muffled as behind you (`behindMuffle`). 90 to 170, in steps of 5. | `100` |
| `field.turnPingDegrees` | How far the camera must turn, in degrees, for the sonar's or a route ping's last sound to play again (`turnPings`). 10 to 90, in steps of 5. | `30` |
| `field.nearbyRadius` | How far the nearby list looks (`nearby`), in steps. 5 to 60, in steps of 5. | `30` |

## Keys

Each key and button the mod uses can be moved, inside a `keys` object, then the feature's object. A key is a letter,
a digit, or F1 to F12, written in quotes: `"Q"`, `"7"`, `"F5"`. Pad buttons are their names, joined by a plus sign when
held together: `"LB+RB"`. `"none"` leaves an action without a key or button.

The button names are A, B, X, Y, LB, RB, LT, RT, Start, Back, LS and RS for pressing the left or right stick, and
DpadUp, DpadDown, DpadLeft and DpadRight.

```json
{ "keys": { "dialogue": { "repeatKey": "Q", "readerButtons": "LT+RT" } } }
```

| Setting | What it does | Default |
|---|---|---|
| `dialogue.repeatKey` | Repeats the last dialogue line. | `"R"` |
| `dialogue.repeatButtons` | The same on the pad. | `"X"` |
| `dialogue.readerKey` | Turns the dialogue reader on or off, in dialogue and in menus. | `"T"` |
| `dialogue.readerButtons` | The same on the pad. | `"LB+RB"` |
| `dialogue.stopKey` | In dialogue, stops the speech (testing: `dialogueKeys`). | `"P"` |
| `dialogue.speakerKey` | In dialogue, says who is speaking, reader on or off (testing: `dialogueKeys`). | `"O"` |
| `dialogue.lineKey` | In dialogue, says the line on screen without its speaker (testing: `dialogueKeys`). | `"U"` |
| `dialogue.stopButtons`, `dialogue.speakerButtons`, `dialogue.lineButtons` | The same three on the pad. | `"none"` |
| `menus.detailsKey` | Reads the rest of the focused menu item's details. | `"F"` |
| `menus.nameReadBackKey` | With Ctrl held, reads back the name you typed, on the name entry screen. | `"R"` |
| `menus.detailsButtons` | The same on the pad. | `"RS"` |
| `battle.statusKey` | In a battle, says each party member's HP and the enemies hit so far. | `"B"` |
| `battle.statusButtons` | The same on the pad, held; a tap reaches the game (Retry on `LS`). | `"LS"` |
| `battle.enemyNextKey` | In a battle, steps to the next enemy hit so far and says its HP (`battleEnemyKeys`). | `"K"` |
| `battle.enemyPreviousKey` | The enemy before. | `"J"` |
| `battle.enemyHpKey` | In a battle, says the HP of every enemy hit so far, in one line. | `"L"` |
| `battle.enemyHoldButtons` | Held for the battle's enemy chords (testing: `battleEnemyPad`). | `"LB"` |
| `battle.enemyNextButton` | With the held button: the next enemy. | `"DpadDown"` |
| `battle.enemyPreviousButton` | With the held button: the enemy before. | `"DpadLeft"` |
| `battle.enemyHpButton` | With the held button: every enemy's HP. | `"DpadRight"` |
| `battle.hpMpKey` | In a battle, says each party member's HP and MP (testing: `battleHpMp`). No pad button yet. | `"M"` |
| `field.nearbyKey` | Speaks the whole nearby list. | `"N"` |
| `field.placeKey` | Says where you are. | `"L"` |
| `field.holdButtons` | Held for the field's pad chords. | `"LB"` |
| `field.nextButton` | With the held button: the next thing on the nearby list. | `"DpadDown"` |
| `field.previousButton` | With the held button: the thing before. | `"DpadUp"` |
| `field.placeButton` | With the held button: where you are. | `"DpadLeft"` |
| `field.guideKey` | Starts or stops the guidance beep. | `"G"` |
| `field.guideButton` | With the held button: starts or stops the guidance beep. | `"DpadRight"` |
| `field.nextKey` | The next thing on the nearby list, from the keyboard. | `"K"` |
| `field.previousKey` | The thing before, from the keyboard. | `"J"` |
| `field.categoryNextKey` | The next nearby category, from the keyboard. | `"]"` |
| `field.categoryPreviousKey` | The category before. | `"["` |
| `field.categoryHoldButtons` | Held for the pad's category chord. | `"none"` |
| `field.categoryButton` | With the held button: the next nearby category. | `"none"` |
| `field.objectiveKey` | Starts the guidance beep toward the current objective (testing: `objectiveGuidance`). | `"O"` |
| `field.objectiveButton` | With the held button: the same. | `"none"` |
| `field.scanKey` | Says the nearest thing ahead, left, right and behind (testing: `stickScan`). | `"U"` |
| `field.walkKey` | Starts or stops auto-walk toward the guidance beep (testing: `autoWalk`). | `"H"` |
| `field.walkButton` | With the held button: the same. | `"Y"` |
| `field.identifyKey` | Debug builds only: logs the nearest thing for the names table. | `"I"` |
| `report.markKey` | Writes a marker to the report log. Keyboard only for now. | `"F8"` |
| `menus.settingsMenuKey` | Opens or closes the mod's settings menu (testing: `settingsMenu`). | `"F2"` |
| `menus.chordButtons` | Held on the pad for the settings menu's and the help's buttons. | `"LT+RT"` |
| `menus.settingsMenuButton` | With the held buttons: opens the settings menu. | `"Back"` |
| `menus.helpKey` | Says the mod's keys that work where you are (testing: `keyHelp`). | `"F1"` |
| `menus.helpButton` | With the held buttons: the same. | `"Y"` |

A key the game also uses still reaches the game whenever the mod isn't using it, so choose one the game leaves free
where you'll press it.
